base: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Single square photoreal early-2000s POV fisheye snapshot. Strong barrel distortion with dark soft corners, subject close to lens, direct compact-camera flash mixed with warm ambient light, slightly grainy 2003 consumer-camera texture. Weird but friendly animal with human anatomical features convincingly attached to its own body. Extremely chill, casual, unbothered mood. Real textures and plausible photographic lighting, surreal anatomy. No text, logos, watermark, collage or cartoon. Scene:
